title: Sequencing: launch content
bodyMd:
Five communications are published in order during a launch. Every communication appears once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Brief, Demo, Guide, Interview, Summary.

- Guide must be immediately followed by Summary.
- Brief must precede Demo.
- Interview must not be in position 1.
- Demo and Summary must not occupy consecutive positions.
